title: Exosomal microRNA-342-5p from adipose-derived stem cells mitigates acute kidney injury in sepsis mice
author: Liu, Hu, et al.
materials: Human AMSCs from Shanghai Zhongqiaoxinzhou Biotech (Shanghai, China) were soaked in MesenCult™-ACF medium (STEMCELL Technologies, CA) supplemented with 2 mM L-glutamine (Thermo Fisher Scientific, Wilmington, DE, USA) and 1% antibiotic antibacterial agent (Thermo Fisher Scientific). The phenotypes of the 3rd to 6th generation of AMSCs were evaluated by flow cytometry analysis (BD Accuri®C6 flow cytometry) after incubation with antibodies against CD29, CD31, CD44, CD45, CD73, CD90, CD105, and HLA-DR (Biolegend, CA, USA). IgG1 served as a negative control. Adipogenic differentiation medium (Invitrogen, Carlsbad, CA, USA), osteogenic differentiation medium (Invitrogen), and chondrogenic differentiation medium (Invitrogen) were used to induce the differentiation of AMSCs. After 14 or 21 days of induction, the cells were stained with Oil Red O dye (Sigma-Aldrich, Merck KGaA, Darmstadt, Germany), Alizarin Red S (Sigma-Aldrich), and Alcian Blue (Sigma-Aldrich).

The human renal proximal tubular epithelial cell line HK-2 (National Collection of Authenticated Cell Cultures, Shanghai, China) was immersed in Dulbecco’s modified Eagle medium (Gibco, Grand Island, NY, USA) containing 10% FBS, 1% penicillin, and 1% streptomycin for cell culture in an incubator at 37 °C and 5% CO2. For the construction of sepsis cellular models, HK-2 cells were induced by 1 µg/mL lipopolysaccharide (LPS, Sigma-Aldrich) for 24 h. To investigate the effect of autophagy on sepsis, HK-2 cells were treated with autophagy activator rapamycin (Rapa, 10 nM, Sigma-Aldrich) or autophagy inhibitor 3-Methyladenine (3-MA, 10 µM, Sigma-Aldrich) for 30 min before LPS treatment. For incubation with exosomes (20 µg), HK-2 cells were treated with LPS (1 µg/mL) for 24 h before being treated by AMSC-Exo for 24 h.

steps.title: Collect serum from subjects
steps.instruction: Obtain peripheral blood from 30 sepsis‑associated AKI patients and 30 healthy volunteers, process to serum and store for measurement of miR‑342‑5p, blood urea nitrogen and serum creatinine.

steps.title: Lentiviral transfection of AMSCs
steps.instruction: Seed 1 × 10⁶ human AMSCs in 10 mL MesenCult™‑ACF medium overnight, then transduce with LV‑miR‑342‑5p or LV‑miR‑67 at MOI = 10. Incubate 24 h, then collect cells for qRT‑PCR analysis.

steps.title: Culture and characterize AMSCs
steps.instruction: Maintain AMSCs in MesenCult™‑ACF medium supplemented with 2 mM L‑glutamine and 1 % antibiotic‑antibacterial solution. Evaluate passages 3‑6 by flow cytometry using antibodies against CD29, CD31, CD44, CD45, CD73, CD90, CD105 and HLA‑DR (IgG1 as negative control). Induce adipogenic, osteogenic and chondrogenic differentiation with the respective Invitrogen media; after 14 days (adipogenic) or 21 days (osteogenic, chondrogenic) stain with Oil Red O, Alizarin Red S or Alcian Blue respectively.

steps.title: Replace medium with exosome‑free serum
steps.instruction: After 24 h of lentiviral transfection, replace the culture medium with exosome‑free fetal bovine serum‑supplemented medium and incubate the AMSCs for an additional 48 h at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂.

steps.title: Isolate exosomes by differential centrifugation
steps.instruction: Collect the conditioned medium and perform sequential centrifugation: 300 × g for 10 min, 2 000 × g for 10 min, then ultracentrifuge at 10 000 × g for 30 min and finally at 100 000 × g for 70 min, all at 4 °C. Resuspend the pellet in PBS and repeat ultracentrifugation at 100 000 × g for 70 min. Resuspend the final exosome pellet in 200 µL PBS for immediate protein quantification or store at –80 °C.

steps.title: Quantify exosome protein (BCA assay)
steps.instruction: Determine exosome protein concentration using the bicinchoninic acid (BCA) protein assay kit (Beyotime) according to the manufacturer’s protocol.

steps.title: Analyze exosome size with Nanosight
steps.instruction: Dilute the exosome suspension 1 : 100, place 1 mL of the diluted sample into a quartz cuvette and measure particle size distribution using the Nano S90 dynamic light‑scattering instrument (Marvin, UK).

steps.title: Culture HK‑2 cells in DMEM
steps.instruction: Seed the human renal proximal tubular epithelial cell line HK‑2 in Dulbecco’s Modified Eagle Medium containing 10 % FBS, 1 % penicillin and 1 % streptomycin, and incubate at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂.

steps.title: Induce HK‑2 sepsis model with LPS
steps.instruction: Treat HK‑2 cells with 1 µg/mL lipopolysaccharide (LPS, Sigma‑Aldrich) for 24 h to mimic sepsis‑associated injury.

steps.title: Detect TLR9 expression
steps.instruction: Measure Toll‑like receptor 9 (TLR9) levels in the LPS‑treated HK‑2 cells (and in mouse kidney samples) using the appropriate detection method.

steps.title: Predict miR‑342‑5p/TLR9 interaction
steps.instruction: Perform a dual‑luciferase reporter gene assay to evaluate the predicted binding between miR‑342‑5p and the TLR9 3′‑UTR.

steps.title: Modulate autophagy in HK‑2 cells
steps.instruction: Pre‑treat HK‑2 cells with either rapamycin (10 nM) or 3‑methyladenine (3‑MA, 10 µM) for 30 min before LPS exposure to activate or inhibit autophagy respectively.

steps.title: Treat HK‑2 cells with exosomes
steps.instruction: After 24 h LPS stimulation, add 20 µg of AMSC‑derived exosomes (AMSC‑Exo‑342 or AMSC‑Exo‑67) to the HK‑2 culture and incubate for an additional 24 h.

steps.title: Transfect HK‑2 cells with nucleic acids
steps.instruction: Plate LPS‑induced HK‑2 cells, incubate for 16 h at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂, then transfect using LipoFiter™ reagent (Hanbio) with 50 nM miR‑342‑5p mimic/inhibitor, miR‑67 mimic/inhibitor, or 2 µg pcDNA3.1‑TLR9 or si‑TLR9 (plus appropriate negative controls from GenePharma). Perform each condition in triplicate and carry out downstream assays 24 h post‑transfection.

steps.title: Perform H&E staining on kidney tissue
steps.instruction: Fix harvested kidney tissue in 10 % paraformaldehyde for 24 h, dehydrate through a graded ethanol series, embed in paraffin, cut 4 µm sections and stain with hematoxylin‑eosin.

steps.title: Conduct statistical analysis
steps.instruction: Analyze data from three independent replicates per group using GraphPad Prism 7.0. Present results as mean ± SD. Compare two groups with a t‑test; compare multiple groups with one‑way ANOVA followed by Tukey’s post‑hoc test. Consider P < 0.05 statistically significant.
